UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: bone
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Charcoal with bone and dark leather. For a colony with no tools to speak of.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: split wood
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Rough split wood with long, uneven grain.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: flagstone
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Irregular flagstones, after the vanilla flagstone floor.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: rock art
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Dark rock with red ochre, and yellow ochre for what's picked. For a tribal colony.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: fieldstone
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Irregular fieldstones with chips, cracks and dark joints.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: tapestry
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Lapis blue and gold, the colours of manuscripts and heraldry. For a medieval colony.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: cut stone
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Interlocking dressed stones with chipped edges and fine cracks.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: brick
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Bricks in staggered courses, after the vanilla stone tile floor.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: coursed drystone
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Rough stones in uneven courses, like a drystone castle wall.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: castle ashlar
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Large dressed stone blocks in straight courses, like a keep wall.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: random rubble
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Flattish stones of mixed size packed without courses.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: levelled rubble
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Bands of rubble between long levelling courses, as in many castle walls.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: engraving
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Iron grey and brass, the colours of engine works and machine shops. For an industrial colony.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: tread plate
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Bolted plates of diamond tread plate, the steel of walkways and engine rooms.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: spacer
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Deep blue with cyan, the colours of ship consoles. For a spacer colony.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: hull panels
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Interlocking steel panels with angled corners and narrow seams.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: orbital platform
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Panel seams and vents, after the Odyssey orbital platform floor.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: ultratech
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Deep plum with magenta. For an ultratech colony.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: hex tiles
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Hexagonal tiles, after the Ideology hex tile floor.

UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.label: archotech
UIRethemed.Core.ThemePaletteDef.description: Olive grey with lime, the colours of archotech gear. For a colony at the archotech level.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: etched circuits
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Plates with angled corners, with lit circuit traces running from their edges to dots and rings, like the archotech structures.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: archotech plates
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Plates and circuit traces taken from the Ideology grand archotech structure.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: rock art
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Eland, hunters, a giraffe and cattle, after African rock art.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: tapestry
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Knights, a longship, a tower, a tree and a hound, after the Bayeux Tapestry.

UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.label: engraving
UIRethemed.Core.PatternDef.description: Gears, a locomotive and a works chimney, after Victorian engineering engravings.
